# deadline-risk

It's not a project tracker. It's deadline-risk management for freelance contractors.

rationale: Very long document with no quotable block.
input:
# Thoughts

We started this project because we were frustrated with the existing tools. There were many of them and none of them did what we wanted. So we built our own. It took a long time. We learned a lot about engineering, about product, about ourselves. The first version was bad. The second version was better. The third version is the one we are launching now. It has features. It has opinions. It has a roadmap. We hope it is useful to somebody. We are not sure who yet. We will find out. Here is the link. Please tell us what you think. We are listening. We are always listening. Thank you for reading this. It means a lot to us. Really.
knownMiss: Short prose with nothing quotable. The document is a wall of first-person narration with no blockquote, no heading structure and no single sentence that survives being pasted out of context — but it is only ~160 words, and every rule that detects a wall of prose keys on length. A pruning rule ('no sentence under 20 words') would not fire either, because two sentences are short. Fixing this properly needs a readability model, not another threshold. Left visible rather than tuned away.
